description: A Network Digital Twin is a continuously updated digital representation of a communication network. It combines measurements, models, and simulation to predict states, test changes safely, and optimize operations, planning, and troubleshooting.

featured.title: Jamming-Resilient Physical-to-Virtual Communications in Digital Twin Edge Networks

featured.summary: Examines “Jamming-Resilient Physical-to-Virtual Communications in Digital Twin Edge Networks”. Focus: threats, protection mechanisms and security-performance trade-offs in Network Digital Twin, giving a quick view of the problem and its role in future wireless and network systems.
